image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The primary element is a curved, dark metal archway with white lettering that appears distorted and partially illegible. Below the arch hangs a rectangular green panel, largely obscured by shadow or design. At the bottom is a weathered, white rectangular sign with large, stylized black characters that resemble gibberish or heavily distorted typography. The signs are mounted on a dark vertical post visible on the right side.
